roadmap_title: CBE Market Intelligence MVP Development Roadmap (Phase 10)

sprints.objective: Eliminate the 15% prediction interval undercoverage using split conformal prediction.
deliverables: Split conformal prediction engine for 80% and 95% quantiles.
Empirical non-conformity score calibration over rolling 2,000 bars.
Reliability diagram generator with Brier score tracking.
acceptance_tests: Observed empirical coverage >= 80% and >= 95% on out-of-fold calibration test set.
sprints.completion_criteria: Undercoverage gap reduced to < 2.0% without expanding interval width by > 25%.

sprints.objective: Expose clean, versioned JSON API endpoints for external consumers and UI clients.
deliverables: Real-time regime, volatility, and basis telemetry payloads.
Rate-limiting and read-only token authentication middleware.
acceptance_tests: API response latency < 20 ms under 100 concurrent requests; 100% schema validation.
sprints.completion_criteria: OpenAPI 3.0 compliant docs generated with zero trading endpoints.

sprints.sprint_title: Dashboard UX Polish & Transparent Limitations Banner
sprints.objective: Upgrade the web dashboard with responsive multi-asset navigation and prominent limitations notices.
deliverables: Clean dark-mode telemetry tiles for Regime, Volatility, and Basis.
Interactive historical Brier score accuracy trend chart.
acceptance_tests: Lighthouse performance score >= 95; zero layout shift; mobile responsive.
sprints.completion_criteria: All displayed indicators have click-to-explain tooltips and mathematical definitions.

sprints.objective: Unify BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, and SOLUSDT into a single synchronized market intelligence view.
acceptance_tests: Memory usage remains < 250 MB RAM with 3 active instruments running concurrently.
sprints.completion_criteria: Synchronized 15m bar ingestion across all 3 symbols with zero timeline misalignment.

sprints.sprint_title: Automated Data Quality & Pipeline Health Telemetry
sprints.objective: Implement autonomous monitoring for stream degradation, stale bars, and exchange disconnects.
deliverables: Stale candle watchdog with automated alerting.
Public uptime and data quality badge on UI.
acceptance_tests: Simulated websocket disconnect triggers 'DEGRADED' badge within 10 seconds.
sprints.completion_criteria: Zero silent failures; all data anomalies visibly flagged to user.

sprints.sprint_title: Controlled MVP Release & Acceptance Verification Gate
sprints.objective: Execute end-to-end security audit, load testing, and formal MVP sign-off.
deliverables: Security penetration test report (confirming zero trading leakage).
acceptance_tests: Passes all 9 MVP Release Acceptance Gates with 100% compliance.
sprints.completion_criteria: Formal sign-off for public read-only deployment.

acceptance_gates.GATE_01_DOCUMENTED_DEFINITIONS: 100% of visible indicators have published mathematical definitions and interpretation guidelines.
acceptance_gates.GATE_02_CALIBRATED_INTERVALS: Observed empirical coverage for conformal intervals is within +/- 2.5% of nominal confidence (>= 77.5% for 80%, >= 92.5% for 95%).
acceptance_gates.GATE_03_TRANSPARENT_LIMITATIONS: Model limitations banner is permanently visible on UI, explicitly disclosing non-financial-advice status and model freeze provenance.
acceptance_gates.GATE_04_DATA_FRESHNESS: End-to-end pipeline latency from bar close to dashboard update is strictly < 30 seconds under normal operation.
acceptance_gates.GATE_05_NO_LOOKAHEAD: Zero lookahead leakage; all prospective signals generated strictly at bar close without forward timestamp access.
acceptance_gates.GATE_06_TRADING_DISABLED: Zero order execution or exchange API key capabilities; APPROVAL4 remains strictly FALSE.
acceptance_gates.GATE_07_PERFORMANCE: Dashboard initial cold load time < 1.0 second; API response latency < 50 ms under 100 concurrent requests.
acceptance_gates.GATE_08_REPRODUCIBILITY: 100% of reported historical validation metrics can be independently reproduced from committed repository artifacts.
acceptance_gates.GATE_09_EXPERIMENTAL_SEPARATION: All fallback or uncalibrated indicators are prominently badged as 'Deneysel / Fallback' with zero ambiguity.
